notes: «جميعا عن حماد بن زيد»: four co-transmitters meet at حماد
«قال أبو الربيع حدثنا حماد» restates the route through Abu al-Rabi' as a second isnad carrying the same saying: its own group, sharing the tail
the shared tail «أيوب، أبي قلابة، أنس» is written once after حماد; the Companion Anas is the last link
